title: Motion inspection ruler
changes: Native range slider with a 44-pixel interaction area, 24-pixel handle, themed fill, and visible focus outline.
Aligned quarter-stroke graduations and a stronger current-position badge.
Playback disables the ruler and removes the misleading filled track.
Operating-system forced-color styling preserves effort diamonds and open load rings in distance previews.

validation.notes: UI suite passed before final spacing and forced-color-only CSS refinements; all final browser runs cover those refinements. Browser validation used Chromium. Firefox slider rules are included but not runtime-tested.

publication: Local only; no commit, push, or deployment
